item: R827 R3(a) + R5/R6(a), amended by R830 (row 408): the import's page walk and safety-net read-back run beside the merge; the live corpus is copied once
summary: The staged copy's quick_check left prepare_staged (structure check only there) and runs on its own thread beside the merge, which only reads the staged copy; a failure refuses before verify and any swap, a failed merge stops the walk and keeps its own error. A committing exclusive restore copies the live corpus ONCE as the safety net (sha256 taken while copying under the write gate, fsync, size and keyed-open checks), clones the working copy from it (copy_file_range) and the commit reuses it instead of a second copy; free space for both is checked first. R830: the net's full read-back hash runs beside the merge too; a mismatch removes and forgets the net and refuses before the swap, corpus untouched. Plaintext or gate-off stores keep the old path. Timings: merge:quick_check(_wait), merge:net_read_back(_wait), snapshot_working_copy:safety_net/clone.
